It was super easy to remove them before I went to bed. The only drawback for me is that there isn't a slightly shorter,  less full version of the lashes for a more natural look.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as easy to apply and remove.
Many customers praise the lashes for looking natural and being soft or lightweight.
Several reviewers say the magnetic lashes stick well and stay on, with some comparing them favorably to other magnetic brands.
A common complaint is that the eyeliner peels or flakes off, sometimes taking the magnets with it.
Some reviewers find the lash styles too large or the band too thick.
